proof_body:
by
  intro a b k x y ha hb hk hk1 hx hy
  have hL : Real.log k ≠ 0 := Real.log_ne_zero_of_pos_of_ne_one hk hk1
  have h1 : x * Real.log a = Real.log k := by rw [← Real.log_rpow ha, hx]
  have h2 : y * Real.log b = Real.log k := by rw [← Real.log_rpow hb, hy]
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    apply hL
    rw [← h1, zero_mul]
  have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    apply hL
    rw [← h2, zero_mul]
  rw [Real.logb, Real.log_mul ha.ne' hb.ne']
  have ea : Real.log a = Real.log k / x := by field_simp; linarith
  have eb : Real.log b = Real.log k / y := by field_simp; linarith
  rw [ea, eb]
  field_simp
target_source: ∀ (a b k x y : ℝ), 0 < a → 0 < b → 0 < k → k ≠ 1 → a ^ x = k → b ^ y = k → 1 / x + 1 / y = Real.logb k (a * b)
